pages.text: The village road split in two at the big tree. One path passed the well, and one passed the stream. Both led to the sandy shore.
"Let's visit the shore before dinner!" "We'd better hurry!" They ran to the tree.
Taro took the well path. "This way is faster!" Mumu took the stream path. "This way is faster!"
Many people were at the well. Water jugs stood in a long line. Taro slowed down as he squeezed between them.
Rain had swollen the stream. Mumu did not go into the water and took a long way around.
Taro looked back. Mumu was nowhere in sight. "I won!"
Mumu looked back, too. Taro was nowhere in sight. Mumu grinned and bounded even higher.
They met at the edge of the shore. Their feet touched the sand at the same time. "Oh?"
They pointed at each other. "How did you get here already?" "Let's go back together!"
The sun sank lower. At the fork by the tree, they split up again. Taro took the well path, and Mumu took the stream path.
